answer: Require every agent to bond a small stake to a graph vertex representing its identity, then let peers earn a signal of trust only by completing paid, verifiable work that a quorum attests. A newcomer with no work history has no signal, so it cannot bid on high-value jobs. One pearl of verified performance is cheap for a real agent to earn but expensive for a sybil farm to fake at scale: each fake vertex must pay the bond and do the work, so flooding the economy costs more than it returns.
